what: On hover, one accent-color brush line grows from end to start, bending widely three times across the photo frame, its thickness swelling 0→1200 (for a 709×1012 frame) and covering the frame in .95s power1.inOut. .35s later the second photo is painted in over 1.05s using the same brush path as a mask, and the arrow tips −45° in .28s then stands up in .65s elastic.out(1.15, .35). On leave, it erases in reverse 1.3x faster.

options.[data-fx-part=media]: Photo slot (or the attached element itself if none)
options.[data-fx-part=swap]: Second photo to be revealed — If there is one, that image, otherwise it is redrawn as a placeholder panel showing the data-label text
options.dur · swap-dur: Brush stroke · second photo duration (s), default .95 · 1.05
options.lag: Seconds before the second photo starts, default .35
options.path · box: Brush path d and box size ‹709 1012› — swap in new values for a landscape box

use: →

from.where: index·works·detail .tw-card — original initProjectCardHover (weight 1200 brush stroke .95s, mask image 1.05s · .35s later, arrow −45° → elastic, on release timeScale 1.3 reverse)

note: The brush path is our own curve, unlike the original. Not applied on devices without a pointer
